name: Peacock Batik
description: A batik design built around the fanned peacock tail.
history: Became popular in Kandyan workshops in the 1950s and 60s.
careTips: Hand wash in cold water and dry in shade.

name: Lotus Bloom
description: Layered lotus petals in soft gradients.
history: Lotus motifs come from Buddhist art across the island.

name: Kandyan Crown
description: Gold thread work inspired by Kandyan court dress.
history: Derived from royal costume of the Kandyan kingdom.
careTips: Dry clean only to protect the thread.

name: Elephant Parade
description: A procession of elephants in bold wax lines.
history: Inspired by Perahera processions.
careTips: Wash inside out in cold water.

name: Sunrise Stripe
description: Warm horizontal bands that fade like a coastal sunrise.
history: Woven by coastal families for everyday sarongs.
careTips: Machine wash gentle; iron on medium heat.

name: Ocean Weave
description: Wave-like checks in blues and whites.
history: Linked to the fishing communities of the south coast.

name: Cinnamon Check
description: Earthy checks named after cinnamon bark.
history: Created by Matara weavers in the mid 20th century.

name: Tea Leaf Print
description: Repeating tea leaf blocks across the cloth.
history: Reflects the hill country tea estates.
careTips: Wash cold; do not tumble dry.

name: Mist Ikat
description: Blurred edges give a misty hill look.
history: Adapted from ikat traditions brought by trade.

name: Jaffna Diamond
description: Diamond lattice in rich reds.
history: Traditional cotton weaving of the northern peninsula.

name: Palmyra Motif
description: Palmyra palm shapes stamped in rows.
history: The palmyra is the symbol tree of Jaffna.

name: Lagoon Dye
description: Wavy tie-dyed threads suggest lagoon water.
history: Made by eastern coast weavers in small cooperatives.

name: Monsoon Rain
description: Streaked wax lines for falling rain.
history: A modern design popular since the 1990s.

name: Sigiriya Frescoe
description: Stitched figures inspired by the Sigiriya paintings.
history: Created for the heritage souvenir trade.

name: Spice Garden
description: Clove, chilli and pepper shapes in repeat.
history: Reflects Matale's spice growing region.

name: Anuradhapura Scroll
description: Scrollwork borders from moonstone carvings.
history: Based on ancient moonstone steps.

name: Dry Zone Loom
description: Sturdy cotton in dry earth colours.
history: Village looms supplied local farmers for generations.

name: Moonstone Dot
description: Concentric dots echo a moonstone.
history: Developed by a Kurunegala batik cooperative.

name: Coconut Palm
description: Coconut fronds in a tight repeat.
history: Coconut is central to the region's economy.

name: Gem Pit
description: Jewel-toned diamonds referencing gem mining.
history: Inspired by Ratnapura's gem industry.

name: Rainforest Canopy
description: Layered leaf shapes from Sinharaja.
history: Created to celebrate the rainforest reserve.

name: Fort Lattice
description: Geometric lattice inspired by Galle Fort windows.
history: Colonial era architecture inspired this motif.

name: Hill Country Plaid
description: Warm wool-cotton plaid for cool nights.
history: Weaving spread with estate communities.
careTips: Dry clean or cool hand wash.

name: Ella Gap Wave
description: Flowing bands echo the Ella mountain gap.
history: A tourism-era design from the 2000s.

name: Trinco Shell
description: Seashell shapes stamped across the cloth.
history: Reflects Trincomalee's seaside.
